first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ, directly actionable, and has demonstrated durable lift in two independent memory records (31 and 86). Simplification at signup and shortened onboarding both improved activation and completion. This addresses both current metrics headwinds without the revenue quality risk of promotional pricing or the uncertain scaling profile of referral incentives in an acquiring-not-retaining environment. Verified memories 31 and 73 to confirm signup simplification durability and to note the pooling caveat in 73 before considering pricing—if pricing emerges as necessary post-test, we do so with eyes open. Enterprise sales assist is valuable but orthogonal to the activation/completion declines. Referral incentives work for *established* customers, not the self-serve cohort driving current acquisition shortfall.
